description: INFLUENCE — tell us about an artifact you publish, rather than waiting for us to find it. Returns 202; a person fetches it, checks it and re-runs the pipeline against it. Track it with check_status. Priced B4 (human work) — included in Influence; otherwise $49.00 as a one-off with its own receipt, never from a prepaid balance. If this is your own company and our data about it is wrong, report_correction is free. See apis://prices.

contact.description: Optional email address we can reply to about this request, e.g. "dev@example.com".

context.description: Optional: one sentence on why you are asking. Never used to rank; read only if a result is wrong.

slug.description: Provider slug — lowercase, hyphenated, as find_providers returns it, e.g. "stripe".

url.description: Public URL of the artifact you publish, e.g. "https://example.com/openapi.yaml".

name: submit_artifact
